items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 1:30 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Councillor P. Singh - Rockway Centre Redevelopment - Potential Land Disposition (Land Disposition Section 239 (2) (c), CSD-2024-199
notes: Councillor P. Singh declared a conflict with regards to Rockway Centre Redevelopment - Potential Land Disposition (Land Disposition Section 239 (2) (c), CSD-2024-199, as he has family that owns property within the vicinity, and he did not participate in any voting or discussion on the matter.
